    close() - Method in class network.client.rmi.RmiVirtualServer
    Closes the connection once (idempotent): stops the sentinel, notifies the server via serverStub.disconnect, unexports the callback and the command executor, notifies the listener and terminates the client process.
    close() - Method in class network.client.socket.SocketVirtualServer
    Closes the connection once (idempotent): stops the sentinel, closes the socket, notifies the listener and terminates the client process.
    close() - Method in interface network.server.core.VirtualView

    close() - Method in class network.server.rmi.RmiVirtualView
    Shuts down this view cleanly: stops the sentinel and terminates the sender executor.
    close() - Method in class network.server.socket.SocketVirtualView
    Shuts down this view cleanly: stops accepting new messages, waits up to 500 ms for in-flight sends to complete, stops the sentinel, and closes the underlying socket.
